logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { fecha: now() as String {format: "dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss a"}, level: p('system.log.level') default "INFO", environment: vars.env, apiName: app.name, flow: flow.name, correlationId: vars.correlationId, httpMethod: attributes.method, uriParam: if (!isEmpty(attributes.uriParams)) attributes.uriParams[0] else null, message: "Initiating orders " ++ attributes.method ++ " request to database", }]

db:update.db:sql: UPDATE orders SET user_id = :user_id, product_name = :product_name, brand = :brand, price = :price, quantity = :quantity, discount = :discount, order_date = :order_date WHERE order_id = :order_id;
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- { order_id: attributes.uriParams.'orderId', user_id: payload.userId as Number, product_name: payload.productName, brand: payload.brand, price: payload.price as Number, quantity: payload.quantity as Number, discount: payload.discount as Number, order_date: payload.orderDate as Date {format: "yyyy-MM-dd"} }]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { "message": "Order updated successfully", "status": "success", "timestamp": now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'"}, "data": { "order_id": (attributes.uriParams[0]) as Number, "user_id": payload.userId, "product_name": payload.productName, "brand": payload.brand, "price": payload.price, "quantity": payload.quantity, "discount": payload.discount, "order_date": payload.orderDate } }

logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { fecha: now() as String {format: "dd-MM-yyyy HH:mm:ss a"}, level: p('system.log.level') default "INFO", environment: vars.env, apiName: app.name, flow: flow.name, correlationId: vars.correlationId, httpMethod: httpMethod: vars.saveMethod, details:{ message: "Order successfully put into database.", affected_rows: payload.affectedRows default 1, data_updated:payload.data } }]
